claims.text: The architecture of the span detector includes a shared lower layer and separate top layers for the span detection and binary classification tasks.
The shared lower layer consists of a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer, and a memory generation layer.
The model employs a one-layer feed forward neural network for the binary classification task.
A bilinear function is used to determine the start and end points of answer spans during reasoning.
